observations: Photo 0 shows a front-loading washing machine with a silver-grey finish.
The control panel has a large central dial with orange indicator lights, and a digital display showing '00:00' and '95°C'.
There is a red sticker on the left side that says 'Washer+Dryer 2in1'.
The machine appears to be in a laundry room with tiled flooring and a white wall.
The door is open, showing a red and white garment inside.
The machine has visible wear and scratches on the front panel.
A white cable is plugged into the top right corner of the machine.
The machine is not running; the display is off except for the initial '00:00' time.

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the machine is not running; the display is off. No proof of internal damage or repair status. The term 'scrap' is subjective and not verifiable from the photo.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal damage or electrical faults not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running through a full wash cycle, including spin and dry, with the control panel lit and the drum rotating.

risks.risk: The machine may have water leakage or drainage issues, which are not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine filling, draining, and emptying without leaks or water pooling.

risks.risk: The machine may have mechanical issues such as a faulty door seal or drum motor.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the door seal and drum interior to check for damage or wear.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running through a full wash cycle, including spin and dry.
Video showing the machine filling, draining, and emptying without leaks.
Close-up photo or video of the door seal and drum interior.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
